claims.claim_text: Ouster has an extensive granted-patent portfolio covering digital lidar (VCSEL + SPAD + micro-optic) that creates material barriers to entry.
claims.subject: Ouster, Inc.
claims.source_quote: We have invested heavily in patents since our inception, pursuing comprehensive coverage of invention families and use cases, with broad international coverage. We believe that our extensive patent coverage creates material barriers to entry for anyone aiming to compete in the digital lidar space.

claims.claim_text: Ouster's DF (Digital Flash) solid-state lidar is designed to meet automaker ADAS requirements and is positioned for production wins with global automotive OEMs.
claims.subject: DF series
claims.object_value: automotive OEM ADAS production wins (pre-SOP, prototype stage)
claims.source_quote: We have manufactured prototypes of our DF sensors for the automotive ADAS market... We believe that the solid-state digital lidar technology in our DF sensors will meet these requirements and lead to production wins and growth in this segment.

claims.claim_text: Two customers accounted for more than 10% of Ouster's revenue in fiscal year 2025, indicating material customer concentration.
claims.subject: Ouster customer base
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, two customers accounted for more than 10% of our revenue.

claims.claim_text: Ouster's higher-volume product manufacturing is outsourced to Benchmark Electronics and Fabrinet at their Thailand facilities.
claims.subject: Ouster manufacturing
claims.source_quote: Our main manufacturing partners are Benchmark Electronics, Inc. (Benchmark) and Fabrinet. Benchmark and Fabrinet manufacture the majority of our products... both of which have manufacturing facilities in Thailand.

claims.claim_text: Ouster's existing liquidity (cash, equivalents, restricted cash and short-term investments of $211.2M at 12/31/2025) is adequate to fund operations for at least twelve months despite recurring losses and a $973.4M accumulated deficit.
claims.subject: Ouster financial position
claims.object_value: $211.2M cash; >=12 months management view; accumulated deficit $973.4M
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025 we had an accumulated deficit of $973.4 million and cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and short-term investments of approximately $211.2 million. Management believes that our existing sources of liquidity will be adequate to fund our operations for at least twelve months...
